src='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    """Mark aligned cells containing the color shared by both fields."""
    divider = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1)
    upper = grid[:divider]
    lower = grid[divider + 1:]
    upper_colors = {value for row in upper for value in row}
    lower_colors = {value for row in lower for value in row}
    shared = upper_colors & lower_colors
    # The fields have one shared color; its aligned overlap is the signal.
    color = next(iter(shared))
    return [[3 if a == color and b == color else 5
             for a, b in zip(upper_row, lower_row)]
            for upper_row, lower_row in zip(upper, lower)]
'''

    first = [row[:col_cut] for row in grid]
    second = [row[col_cut + 1:] for row in grid]
